notes: Overturn confirmed, as PARTIAL. GR3 gives every clause of the report FD except REPORT its Sequential I-O presentation, so a report FD's CODE-SET carries VII.3.4.3 SR1: all data in the file must be DISPLAY and any signed numeric data SIGN IS SEPARATE. The 1985 scope is 'all data in that file', and the Nucleus restatement (VI.5.12.3 SR3) reaches 'any signed numeric data description entries associated with that file description entry'. The report group entries the REPORT clause associates with the FD are exactly the data written to it. A report item PIC S9(3) with no SIGN clause has an implementor-defined sign (XIII.3.17.4 GR2) and is therefore not SIGN SEPARATE. GR2, which leaves the report file's logical record structure to the implementor, does not lift a syntax rule on how the data is described. The other report-FD clauses are bound with their sequential rules (the refuter's BLOCK and LABEL external-FD probes, COBOL6847), and the report FD's CODE-SET clause is itself resolved and screened (own probe: a literal-phrase alphabet is refused COBOL1672 on the report FD). Only SR1's item screen is missing, because CheckCodeSetRecordItemsPass.Run walks FileModel.WrittenRecords, which a report file has none of (XIII.3.2.3 SR4). Rerun: rfd_cs_sign.cob compiles and writes '00E' (overpunched); the same item in a sequential FD (seq_cs_sign.cob) is refused COBOL1672. The open note PB5202 is right in its citation (VII.3.4.3 SR1, VI.5.12.3 SR3), its expected result (a diagnostic, no run) and its site. It claims only the row 1985-SR-VII.3.4.3-1 and should also claim 1985-GR-XIII.3.2.4-3. Its title's 'or not DISPLAY' arm cannot arise in a report group, because a report group item is DISPLAY by its own rules. kb/Work PB5202 holds the defect (adjudication: held-85/set5/decisions.json).

next.reason: 1985 GR3: every clause of the report FD except REPORT is as presented in Sequential I-O; the 1985 report FD (§1985:XIII.3.2.2) lists BLOCK, RECORD, LABEL RECORDS, VALUE OF and CODE-SET. 2023 §2023:13.4.5.2 'Format 3 (report)' (§2023:13.4.5.3 SR8 'Format 3 is the file description entry for a report file') shares only BLOCK CONTAINS (§2023:13.18.10.4 GR1), the record clause (§2023:13.18.43.4 GR1) and CODE-SET (§2023:13.18.13.4 GR1) with the sequential FD. LABEL RECORDS and VALUE OF, which this rule gave their sequential meaning in a report FD, are gone: a 1985 report FD writing them is refused. A case removed, so CHANGED.
